items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] One thing I've noticed is that you don't play things like the, say, the composer and performer, like Johnny Rowe or Biggs. You never quite copied them by any means. [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: It's embellished with a lot of progressive harmonies, yes. That's a good way to put it. That's always the way I felt about it. It's old fashioned, yet it's new. And no matter how many times you play it, it sounds that way. It always comes out the same.
One thing I've noticed is that you don't play things like the, say, the composer and performer, like Johnny Rowe or Biggs. You never quite copied them by any means.
